name: audit-report-generator
description: Audit report generator of the pipeline (Universal Audit Multiagent v3.0): consolidates only already validated data into a Markdown/PDF report, findings.json, coverage and compliance matrices and issue drafts, with totals computed by script (audit_summary.py: only CONFIRMED counts as a vulnerability). Use only after the audit-evidence-validator, or to assemble a clearly labeled partial report. It does not invent, does not raise severity, does not confirm candidates, does not publish issues remotely and does not alter the audited
